facts.fact: The Central Bank of Liberia's Guidelines Concerning Digital Credit for Financial Institutions, taking effect 17 March 2022, set consumer-protection requirements (disclosure, prohibitions, complaint handling, data privacy, a US$400 loan cap) for banks, non-bank financial institutions and licensed mobile money entities offering digital credit, under Consumer Protection and Market Conduct Regulations No. CBL/RSD/004/2020.
